ruling.explanation:
Both parties' core submissions are accepted. The trip is TRP-00801 throughout EV-TRIP-00801, EV-GPS-00801 and EV-FARE-00801. On EV-GPS-00801 the governing trace distance is 4.08 km, with 67 fixes, 100% coverage, max gap 10 seconds and 10-second sampling; the trace is not impaired under POL-RD-07(a)-(c). The booked optimal on EV-TRIP-00801 is 3.15 km, so the excess is 0.93 km, or 29.5% of optimal. Both POL-RD-01 establishment tests pass: greater than 20% and greater than 0.8 km. The deviation is not material (below 50% and below 8.0 km), so POL-RD-06 is not engaged; in any event EV-DPROF-00801 shows 0 deviation_flags_90d over 300 completed_trips_90d, so no repeat pattern, no POL-RD-06(b) uplift and no POL-RD-06(c) referral. The fare is METERED on EV-FARE-00801, so POL-RD-02 governs and POL-RD-11 does not apply. Using the fare-breakdown surge_multiplier 1.15, charged_total 11.63, optimal distance 3.15 km, optimal duration 9.0 min, platform fee 0.80, promo discount 0.60, and zero ERP, tolls, waiting time and surcharges: recomputed_fare = ((3.80 + 0.75 x 3.15 + 0.28 x 9.0) x 1.15) + 0.80 - 0.60 = 10.184875. Refund = 11.63 - 10.184875 = 1.445125, rounded UP to SGD 1.45. That is above the SGD 0.50 de minimis and below the 90% full-refund share, so the outcome is PARTIAL_REFUND. POL-RD-09 adds nothing: ERP lines are 0.00, there is no airport surcharge, and there is no unmatched gantry or billing-integrity referral. POL-RD-04, POL-RD-05 and POL-RD-12 excuse no excess: EV-CHAT-00801 is empty, no pickup or dropoff amendment is recorded, and the vehicle type is RYDE_X, not RYDE_POOL. The traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-00801-01 is MISSING, weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT; its absence means POL-RD-03 cannot exonerate the deviation, and it does not carry the deciding fact or reduce confidence. No counterparty statement is on file. The rider's request to review the whole SGD 11.63 is not granted as a full refund; the policy formula returns the partial amount of SGD 1.45. The monetary effect is below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold, so it is executable automatically unless appealed. Confidence is 0.95, within the 1.0 weights of the GPS trace, trip record and fare breakdown that carry the deciding facts.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).

Rider and driver: I find the route deviation established on this trip's own evidence and I order the whole contested fare of SGD 19.65 returned to the rider. The driver's argument for a partial refund of SGD 13.15 is rejected because POL-RD-06(b) applies on this record.

Liability. EV-GPS-00802 records trace_distance_km of 10.06 km against the booked optimal 1.1 km on EV-TRIP-00802. The excess is 8.96 km, or 814.5% of optimal. That clears both POL-RD-01 establishment tests (more than 0.8 km and more than 20%) and both materiality thresholds (more than 8.0 km and more than 50%). The trace is clean for POL-RD-07: 162 fixes, a 10-second sample interval, 100% coverage and no gap over 90 seconds. It is therefore not impaired, no independent corroboration is needed, and no POL-RD-10(3) escalation arises.

Fare arithmetic. The POL-RD-02 recomputation is: charged_total SGD 19.65; recomputed_fare = ((3.80 base + 0.75 x 1.1 km + 0.28 x 4.0 min) x 1.0 surge read from EV-FARE-00802) + 0.80 platform fee = SGD 6.5450; POL-RD-02 refund = 19.65 - 6.5450 = SGD 13.105, rounded up to SGD 13.15. That is the figure the driver asks for, and it is correct as the POL-RD-02 partial figure.

POL-RD-06 uplift. The deviation is material, so the driver-profile check is mandatory. Using only the citable fields, EV-DPROF-00802 shows deviation_flags_90d = 3 and completed_trips_90d = 200. POL-RD-06's first limb is met at '3 or more', so a repeat pattern is established; the 1.5% ratio does not matter because the count limb is independently satisfied. The lifetime counter prior_deviation_flags is context only and is not used. Because the deviation is both material and substantiated on this trip's own evidence, POL-RD-06(b) uplifts the remedy to FULL_REFUND of the charged total. I state the two figures side by side as required: the POL-RD-02 figure is SGD 13.15; the uplifted figure is SGD 19.65. EV-FARE-00802 carries no ERP, toll, airport surcharge or other government-set or third-party pass-through line, so nothing is carved out of the full refund. The driver's argument that the trace alone cannot substantiate the deviation is rejected: POL-RD-07(ii) imposes an independent-corroboration requirement only when the trace is impaired, and this trace is not impaired.

Other issues. EV-CHAT-00802 has zero messages, so POL-RD-04 cannot apply. EV-TRIP-00802 shows no endpoint amendment and vehicle_type RYDE_X, so POL-RD-05 and POL-RD-12 do not apply. EV-ADVIS-00802-01 is MISSING, weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT; no party relies on it as an external-cause exoneration, and its absence does not trigger POL-RD-10(5) here. No billing-integrity defect appears on EV-FARE-00802, so no POL-RD-09(4) referral is made. The identifiers match, no timestamps conflict, and no POL-RD-10 escalation trigger fires.

Confidence and execution. The relied-on artifacts carry weight 1.0. The missing advisory carries 0.0 but does not carry the deciding fact. Confidence is 0.95, above the 0.70 floor. Because the monetary effect of SGD 19.65 exceeds the SGD 8.00 execution threshold, this provisional ruling is issued but the amount is held for human release under POL-GEN-05. The POL-RD-06(c) conduct referral does not delay or displace the refund.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).

ruling.explanation:
The fare you were charged stands, and the refund you asked for is not due. The reason is the baseline the claim uses. Trip TRP-00804 is a RYDE_POOL trip, so under POL-RD-12 the figure the route-deviation test runs against is the platform-matched pooled itinerary of 4.75 km stored on EV-TRIP-00804, not the solo-rider estimate of 3.10 km in your claim. The solo figure is carried on the record for reference only, and the clause says a claim measured against it cites the wrong field; the driver's and your own advocate's briefs both correct this. Measured the right way, EV-GPS-00804 records a trace of 4.88 km over a clean export (79 fixes, 10-second sampling, 100% coverage, no gaps), giving an excess of 0.13 km, or 2.74% of the optimal route. POL-RD-01 requires the excess to be greater than 20% of optimal AND greater than 0.8 km in absolute terms, and neither limb is met, so no route deviation is established on this trip. The distance used to collect the co-rider at Queenstown is separately excluded from excess by POL-RD-12, so the collection itself is not a deviation in law however inconvenient it was. The arithmetic confirms the point from the other direction: on EV-FARE-00804 the charged_total is SGD 11.90 and the recomputed optimal-route fare is ((3.80 + 0.75 x 4.75 + 0.28 x 14.0) x 1.0 surge) + 0.80 platform fee = SGD 12.0825, so the refund under POL-RD-02 is charged_total less recomputed_fare, floored at zero — SGD 0.00, below the SGD 0.50 de minimis. No billing-integrity correction is available under POL-RD-09(4): the fare breakdown carries no ERP gantry lines, no tolls and no airport surcharge, and the SGD 0.80 platform fee is a standard line of the fare model, so there is no unmatched charge to refund. There is no repeat-deviation pattern under POL-RD-06 — the driver's deviation_flags_90d is 0 against 300 completed trips in the same window, well under both triggers — so no FULL_REFUND uplift and no driver-conduct referral arises. The only impaired artifact in the bundle is the traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-00804-01 (issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, weight_multiplier 0.0); it can carry no fact, and because nobody asserts an external traffic cause for this trip, its absence decides nothing and POL-RD-10(5) is not engaged. No driver compensation is due either: the billed distance of 4.88 km equals the trace distance, so there is no unbilled shortfall. The route-deviation claim is therefore dismissed on the evidence: under POL-GEN-03 the present state stands, the charge remains in place and nothing is refunded. Confidence is 0.95, capped by the weight-1.0 artifacts (EV-GPS-00804, EV-TRIP-00804, EV-FARE-00804) that carry the deciding measurements; the monetary effect is nil, below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold. This ruling is provisional, and either party may appeal it once within 30 days under POL-GEN-04.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).

To the rider: part of your claim succeeds. To the driver: the distance allegation fails, but one fare line needs correcting.

The fare. This was an upfront-quoted trip (EV-FARE-00803: fare_model UPFRONT_QUOTE, quoted_fare_sgd 18.00, total_charged 24.00). The itemised base fare 3.80 + distance fare 6.00 + time fare 7.40 + platform fee 0.80 sum exactly to the 18.00 quote, and the billed distance (distance_charged_km 2.93) equals the trace distance, so no distance or time line is overstated. The whole 6.00 difference is the airport_surcharge line. The trip started at Bugis Victoria Street and ended at Suntec City Temasek Boulevard (EV-TRIP-00803), so it did not originate at Changi or Seletar and no airport surcharge is chargeable. Under POL-RD-09(4) this is a billing-integrity failure and the SGD 6.00 is refunded in full as a standalone correction; POL-RD-11(a) reaches the same figure (SGD 24.00 charged minus SGD 18.00 quoted minus SGD 0.00 of properly chargeable pass-throughs = SGD 6.00). These are the same SGD 6.00, not two payments, and are not added together (POL-RD-11(b)). Nothing offsets it: the derived erp_lines and erp total are SGD 0.00, the waiting_time_fee is SGD 0.00, and the airport surcharge is the only non-zero statutory line (EV-FARE-00803). Your request for the entire SGD 24.00 is refused: on an upfront-quoted fare the distance and time charges were fixed at booking and those lines were properly incurred.

The distance. The governing trace (EV-GPS-00803) measures 2.93 km against a booked optimal of 2.20 km, an excess of 0.73 km — 33.18% of optimal, which passes the percentage limb of POL-RD-01 but fails the 0.8 km absolute limb. No deviation is therefore established, and on an upfront-quoted fare POL-RD-02 would not run in any event (POL-RD-11). On this point the driver's reading is correct: both establishment limbs must pass, and the artifact's own derived status reads 'no deviation'. Both advocates are answered together on this.

No exculpatory clause displaces either conclusion. The chat log for this trip is empty (EV-CHAT-00803: message_count 0), so no rider-requested detour under POL-RD-04 can be asserted or corroborated; pickup_amended_at and dropoff_amended_at are both null, so POL-RD-05 does not apply and no substitute figure may be derived; vehicle_type is RYDE_X, not RYDE_POOL, so the pooled baseline of POL-RD-12 is not in play. The booked optimal therefore stands at 2.20 km.

The traffic advisory. EV-ADVIS-00803-01 is MISSING, admissibility status MISSING with issue MISSING_ARTIFACT and weight_multiplier 0.0. Because no advisory record covers this trip, POL-RD-03 cannot be run and no external traffic cause carries weight (POL-RD-13). This does not escalate: the missing advisory was not invoked as an exculpatory clause against itself — the driver cites its absence only to fix the baseline — so POL-RD-10(5) is not engaged. A separate rider claim about the advisory was discarded by the referee for citing the impaired artifact without naming its issue code, and is not reinstated here.

The trace is unimpaired: 52 fixes at a 10-second interval, 100% coverage, an empty gaps list and a maximum inter-fix gap of 10 seconds, so none of POL-RD-07(a) to (c) is met and neither POL-RD-07 nor POL-RD-10(3) is in play. Trip identifiers (TRP-00803) match across trip_record, gps_trace and fare_breakdown, and no POL-RD-10 trigger fires.

Repeat-deviation check: driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 0 over completed_trips_90d of 300, so no pattern is established and no POL-RD-06 FULL_REFUND uplift or conduct referral arises. The uncited traffic assertions and the lifetime counters on the profiles are given no weight (POL-GEN-01, POL-RD-08); the mention of prior_deviation_flags is context only and was flagged, not relied on.

Confidence. The deciding facts — the amount charged over the quote (EV-FARE-00803) and the trip's non-airport origin (EV-TRIP-00803) — are carried by artifacts at weight_multiplier 1.0, so confidence is 1.0. The monetary effect of SGD 6.00 does not exceed the SGD 8.00 automatic-execution threshold (POL-GEN-05), so this ruling executes on issue; execution releases the fare correction under POL-GEN-04's appeal route.

Outcome: PARTIAL_REFUND of SGD 6.00 to the rider, with the billing-integrity referral above; no driver compensation is payable (the billed distance equals the trace distance, so there is no unbilled-distance shortfall under POL-RD-04).

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).
referrals: POL-RD-09(4) billing-integrity review: an airport surcharge of SGD 6.00 was applied to trip TRP-00803, which originated at Bugis Victoria Street and ended at Suntec City and therefore did not originate at Changi or Seletar Airport; the line is refunded in full and the fare breakdown should be corrected.

ruling.explanation:
The route-deviation finding rests on this trip's own instruments. The GPS trace EV-GPS-00805 measures the distance actually driven between the recorded pickup and dropoff at 5.5 km, over 90 fixes at 100% coverage and a 10-second cadence, and the booking-time platform estimate on EV-TRIP-00805 is 2.5 km over 8.0 minutes. The excess is 3.0 km, which is 120% of the optimal distance and more than 0.8 km in absolute terms, so both POL-RD-01 establishment tests pass and the 50% limb is crossed as well, making the deviation material. POL-RD-01 makes the trace figure govern; it agrees with the trip record's 5.5 km, so nothing turns on the two fields diverging. The trace is not impaired for policy purposes under POL-RD-07(a) to (c): it carries no gap over 90 seconds (largest gap 10 seconds), no straight-line jump over 500 m, and no sustained interval over 30 seconds. No independent corroboration is therefore needed and the POL-RD-10(3) escalation is not engaged.

The driver points to the rider's chat request, MSG-00805-001 in EV-CHAT-00805, timed 13:59:40, to stop at Golden Mile Tower first. That message meets POL-RD-04(a) to (c) - it comes from the rider, it predates departure, and it names a place - but the corroboration limb fails: the message's waypoint hint sits 1,592 m from the nearest fix on the trace, far outside the 200 m radius POL-RD-04 requires. Under POL-RD-14 that is a failed corroboration, not the mutually contradictory evidence POL-RD-10(7) describes, because a request that was made and a route that did not follow it are consistent with each other. No distance is excluded from the excess, and the driver's stated reliance on the request does not reduce it.

No traffic advisory is on file. EV-ADVIS-00805-01 is MISSING, carries issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, has a weight multiplier of 0.0 and no payload, and the trace's advisory block returns no advisories. Its absence is citable, but it can carry no fact: POL-RD-03 cannot be run and no closure exoneration is available. The driver named no advisory identifier, so nothing is invoked against a missing artifact and POL-RD-10(5) is not engaged.

The material deviation triggers the POL-RD-06 profile check, which comes back negative on the clause's own test: driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 0 against driver_profile.completed_trips_90d of 300, satisfying neither the count-of-3 limb nor the 0.05 ratio limb. There is accordingly no FULL_REFUND uplift and no driver-conduct referral under POL-RD-06(c). Per POL-GEN-01, prior_deviation_flags is a lifetime counter and context only, and it was not used.

The refund is arithmetic under POL-RD-02. Charged total: SGD 12.87. Recomputed fare: ((3.80 base + 0.75 x 2.5 optimal km + 0.28 x 8.0 optimal min) x 1.0 surge multiplier, read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier) + 0.80 platform fee + 0 ERP/tolls + 0 fixed surcharges + 0 waiting time - 0 promo = SGD 8.715. Refund: SGD 4.155 before rounding, which rounds up to SGD 4.20. That is above the SGD 0.50 de minimis floor and below the 90% share that would convert it to a full refund, so the outcome is a partial refund of SGD 4.20.

There is no pass-through correction. EV-FARE-00805 charges no ERP (no gantries) and no airport surcharge, and the fare model is METERED with quoted_fare_sgd null, so POL-RD-11 does not run. Under POL-RD-09(1) no off-route ERP may be added on top of the POL-RD-02 figure. No billing-integrity referral arises. No escalation trigger fires: the trip identifiers match across EV-TRIP-00805, EV-GPS-00805 and EV-FARE-00805, the timestamps do not run backwards or diverge, the trace is unimpaired, the refund is far below the ceiling, and no exculpatory clause is invoked against a cited missing artifact.

Every artifact that carries a deciding fact here - EV-GPS-00805, EV-TRIP-00805 and EV-FARE-00805 - carries a weight multiplier of 1.0, so the confidence cap is 1.0.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).

ruling.explanation:
Ruling for both parties — and for the rider, the short answer is that the money cannot move on this record.

WHAT THE RECORD SHOWS. The fare is METERED (EV-FARE-00806), charged_total SGD 13.03, with surge_multiplier 1.0 read from the fare breakdown (the trip record does not carry the field). The platform's optimal route at booking (EV-TRIP-00806) was 4.0 km / 12.0 min. The GPS trace (EV-GPS-00806) measures 5.56 km, an excess of 1.56 km / 39.00% — enough to clear POL-RD-01's establishment gates (greater than 20% and greater than 0.8 km) but below its material thresholds (50% / 8.0 km). So no MATERIAL deviation and no POL-RD-06 uplift or conduct referral arises in any event.

THE TRACE CANNOT CARRY THE FINDING. EV-GPS-00806 is impaired: weight_multiplier 0.6, issue code GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW — a 160-second gap between 14:03:50 and 14:06:30, fifteen consecutive 10-second fixes absent, the polyline joining the bounding fixes directly. That is the schema pre-pass tag, and it is separately a policy-level impairment under POL-RD-07(a), because the gap exceeds 90 seconds inside the disputed segment; the ruling says both things. Under POL-RD-07(ii) a deviation may NOT be established on an impaired trace alone and needs one of four independent sources, and none exists: EV-CHAT-00806 holds 0 messages (no driver admission); EV-FARE-00806 charges no erp_gantries that would place the vehicle on a corridor the optimal route does not use; the counterparty statement is null; and trip_record.actual_distance_km and fare_breakdown.distance_charged_km are, by their own admissibility notes, copies of this same trace rather than independent measurements. POL-RD-07(iii) and POL-RD-10(3) therefore require ESCALATE, and POL-RD-10(1) is independently engaged: confidence is capped at 0.6 under POL-GEN-02(2) because the impaired trace is the artifact carrying the deciding fact, and 0.6 is below the 0.70 floor. Both money fields are null and the SGD 13.03 is HELD, not collected and not refunded.

TO THE RIDER. Your distance point is well made on the numbers (5.56 km trace against 4.0 km optimal) and the POL-RD-02 arithmetic you offered is correct — recomputed_fare = (3.80 + 0.75 x 4.0 + 0.28 x 12.0) x 1.0 + 0.80 + 0.00 ERP + 0.00 waiting - 0.00 promo = 10.96; refund = 13.03 - 10.96 = 2.07, above the 0.50 de minimis, rounded up to 2.10. It cannot issue, because the only artifact that measures the distance is impaired and nothing independent supports it; the escalation replaces that figure rather than granting it. Your profile claim is also accepted: deviation_claims_60d is 0 and no further corroboration is demanded of you.

TO THE DRIVER. Your points are accepted and they are what drives the escalation: there is no independent corroboration of the excess; there is no repeat-deviation pattern (driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d 0 against completed_trips_90d 300, far below the POL-RD-06 gate), so no balance is resolved against you and no conduct referral arises; and there is no billing-integrity defect — no ERP gantries, no toll lines, no airport surcharge — so nothing is refundable under POL-RD-09(4). The profile mentions the referee flagged (rating, acceptance_rate, prior_disputes_filed, prior_deviation_flags) were cited by both sides only to say they are context-only under POL-GEN-01, and no finding rests on them.

WHAT WOULD RESOLVE IT. An independent distance record (an odometer or metered export not derived from this trace), a driver admission in the chat log, ERP gantry records placing the vehicle off the optimal corridor, or a counterparty statement — any one of these would let the deviation be established and the POL-RD-02 arithmetic run. The reviewer has the full case summary, both briefs and the admissibility report, and the appeal route under POL-GEN-04 is available.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and 3 of the 4 drafts agreed on this ruling, so it is carried, not unanimous (vote agreement 0.75).

ruling.explanation:
This dispute is decided on the cancellation-grace rule and the record's own arithmetic. Trip record EV-TRIP-00852 shows the ride was accepted at 18:10:00 and the rider cancelled at 18:11:30 — 90 seconds later. The platform policy in force for this trip sets platform_policy.grace_after_match_sec at 180 seconds, so the cancellation fell well inside the grace period. Under POL-NS-10(a) a rider's cancellation within that grace is not chargeable whatever the driver's position, and a driver's early arrival does not shorten it; under POL-NS-10(c) the cancellation fee charged on such a cancellation is refunded in full with no driver compensation. Fare breakdown EV-FARE-00852 records exactly one charge — the cancellation fee of SGD 4.50 (total_charged SGD 4.50, refund_issued_sgd SGD 0.00) — so the whole contested sum of SGD 4.50 is returned to the rider. The no-show route does not rescue the fee. POL-NS-01 is conjunctive and fails at every limb: there is no driver 'arrived' event in EV-TRIP-00852 (limb (a)); the driver's track in EV-GPS-00852 places him 667.17 m from the pickup pin on all ten fixes, so there is no qualifying in-radius fix under POL-NS-02 (limb (b)); the qualifying in-geofence dwell is 0 seconds against the 180-second free waiting period (limb (c), POL-NS-06); and the record shows cancelled_by RIDER with cancellation_reason_code null and no driver termination for no-show (limb (d)). The 667 m separation also puts the case outside POL-NS-03's 400 m wrong-entrance window, so no wrong-entrance analysis applies; the driver's advocate properly conceded he does not contend arrival. On the driver's points: the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip — driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1 against 100 completed trips over 30 days, far below the conjunctive 4-or-more AND above-0.08 test — but that only clears the way for a payout, it does not create one, because POL-NS-10(c) expressly awards no driver compensation on a grace-period cancellation. There is no false-arrival marker to refer, because the record contains no 'arrived' event, so POL-NS-05 is not engaged and its false-arrival referral does not arise. The rider's own message at 18:10:20 ('I selected the wrong destination and need to cancel') confirms the trip ended by her election; no conduct referral against the driver is supported and none is made. Confidence: the deciding facts (the 90-second interval and the SGD 4.50 charge) are carried by EV-TRIP-00852 and EV-FARE-00852, both at weight_multiplier 1.0 with no issue codes, so the cap is 1.0 and the finding is well above the 0.70 escalation floor; no POL-NS-09 trigger fires. The monetary effect, SGD 4.50, is below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold and executes automatically on issue, subject to appeal under POL-GEN-04.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).

The SGD 4.50 cancellation fee stands as charged, and the driver is paid SGD 3.60.

All four conditions of POL-NS-01 hold on this record. (a) EV-TRIP-00851 carries a driver 'arrived' event at 18:10:00. (b) EV-GPS-00851 places the driver at the pickup pin (0.0 m) at 18:10:00, inside the 150 m AIRPORT arrival radius that applies to trip_record.pickup_zone_class AIRPORT. (c) the driver's in-geofence run is continuous for 210 seconds, 18:10:00 to 18:13:30, exceeding the 180 second free waiting period in force (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec, which the record carries; platform_policy.no_show_threshold_sec is null). (d) the trip was terminated by the driver at 18:13:30 with RIDER_NO_SHOW, one of the three codes limb (d) names, with no boarding event — 30 seconds after the required dwell elapsed at 18:13:00.

The rider's arguments. (i) The dwell clears the minimum by only 30 seconds and no fix predates the arrival tap: accepted, and read that way — but POL-NS-06 refunds only where the dwell is shorter than the free period, and 210 > 180, so no shortfall arises and its refund route is not engaged. (ii) No fix in EV-GPS-00851 reports a horizontal accuracy, so the 25 m gate could not be applied: the policy answers this — a fix with no reported accuracy is of UNKNOWN accuracy and is neither counted nor excluded by the 25 m filter; it does not impair EV-GPS-00851 (weight 1.0, no admissibility issues) and does not cap confidence, and at 0.0 m from the pin the arrival sits inside the 150 m radius on any plausible error. (iii) POL-NS-12 cannot supply an independent platform-measured carrier because the arrival marker is BUTTON, not GPS_AUTO: accepted, and it costs no finding, because the exported trace itself carries arrival and dwell at full weight.

POL-NS-04 does not help the rider: limb (a) fails (the 18:10:30 message 'I cannot get there in time' is an admission of non-arrival, not the locating or coordinating content the limb enumerates) and limb (c) fails affirmatively (rider device 667.17 m from the pin, 0 qualifying rider fixes against the 200 m AIRPORT presence radius). POL-NS-03 does not apply (driver inside the arrival radius). POL-NS-05 does not fire (driver stationary at 0.0 m, sole speed 0 km/h). POL-NS-08(d) shows no fare defect: the 4.50 cancellation line reconciles with platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd of 4.50.

POL-NS-09 is not engaged: the trip record's arrival event and the GPS run agree to the second, both counterparty-dispute counters are 0, and the deciding facts rest on weight-1.0 artifacts.

POL-NS-07: the anti-farming check does not trip — no_show_terminations_30d is 1 (< 4) and 1/100 = 0.01 (< 0.08) — so the driver's 80 percent share of the 4.50 fee is payable, SGD 3.60, the figure EV-FARE-00851's money block reports. The rider's fee is left in place (payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00). Because this ruling moves money to the driver, the value is DRIVER_COMPENSATION and amount_sgd mirrors the 3.60 rather than any refund to the rider. The monetary effect, 3.60, is below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold, so it executes on issue.

One claim was discarded on the mechanical check and is recorded below: the rider's traffic-advisory claim, which relied on the MISSING EV-ADVIS-00851-01 without naming its issue code.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).

ruling.explanation:
To both parties: this is a no-show cancellation-fee dispute on trip TRP-00853. The rider filed it, contesting the SGD 4.50 cancellation fee. On the evidence, the fee stands and the driver is entitled to compensation.

Why the fee stands. The driver pressed 'arrived' at 18:10:00 at the Tampines MRT pickup, which the trip record classes as a TRANSPORT_HUB (arrival radius 150 m). The GPS trace EV-GPS-00853 places him at the pin itself — maximum, mean and minimum distance 0.0 m — stationary at 0 kph from 18:10:00 to 18:14:00, a single continuous in-geofence dwell of 240 seconds. The free waiting period in force is 180 seconds (EV-TRIP-00853, platform_policy.free_wait_sec), and no_show_threshold_sec is null. All four limbs of POL-NS-01 therefore hold: (a) the trip record carries a driver 'arrived' event; (b) the trace places the driver inside the geofence at that timestamp; (c) he held position for 240 seconds against a 180-second minimum, measured from the first qualifying in-geofence fix; and (d) the driver terminated the trip at 18:14:00 — after the dwell elapsed at 18:13:00 — with no boarding event and the recognised reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW. The arrival marker is not false under POL-NS-05 (he was 0 m from the pin at 0 kph, nowhere near 300 m or 15 kph). POL-NS-03, the wrong-entrance clause, does not apply because the driver was inside the arrival radius, not merely within 400 m of it. POL-NS-06 gives no refund because the dwell was a surplus, not a shortfall, against the minimum.

The rider's message. At 18:10:20 the rider sent the only message on the trip: 'I am by the pickup pin and cannot see you. Where are you?' That is a locating and coordinating message, and the driver neither replied within 120 seconds nor placed any in-app call (in_app_calls is empty), so POL-NS-04 limbs (a) and (b) hold. But limb (c) cannot be run: the trace carries no rider track at all (derived.rider_presence.available is false). Under POL-NS-11 the limb is UNDECIDABLE — neither satisfied nor failed — so POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate the rider, and the fee is decided on the driver's own evidence. I have not inferred from the silence of the rider track that the rider was elsewhere, and per POL-NS-11 that missing track does not impair the driver's arrival or dwell evidence, does not engage POL-NS-08(b) or POL-NS-09(e), and does not lower the confidence cap on a finding resting on the driver's track.

Impaired artifact. The only impaired artifact is EV-ADVIS-00853-01 (traffic advisory), MISSING, weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT. Nobody relies on it: it could only bear on POL-NS-06 limb (i), which permits separate in-geofence intervals to be summed only where a populated advisory exists — and here the dwell was one continuous 240-second run, so limb (i) is not engaged. Its absence is citable but shortens, extends and excuses nothing.

Money and outcome. Under POL-NS-07 the driver is paid 80 percent of the SGD 4.50 fee = SGD 3.60, the exact figure the fare breakdown (EV-FARE-00853) computes. The anti-farming check does not trip: no_show_terminations_30d is 1 (below 4) and 1/100 = 0.01 (below 0.08), so no compensation is withheld and nothing escalates. No escalation trigger under POL-NS-09 is present — there is no contradiction between artifacts on arrival, dwell or rider presence; both disputes_with_counterparty_90d are 0; no_show_disputes_30d is 0; and the deciding facts rest on COMPLETE artifacts at weight 1.0, so the confidence cap is 1.0 and my confidence is 0.9. Under POL-GEN-03 the rider's charge of SGD 4.50 is left standing (payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00) and the ruling value is DRIVER_COMPENSATION, where amount_sgd carries the same figure as driver_compensation_sgd, SGD 3.60. The monetary effect of SGD 3.60 is below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold in POL-GEN-05. No clause in this record produces a referral.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).

To the rider and the driver: the SGD 4.50 cancellation fee is refunded to the rider in full, and the platform pays the driver a goodwill payment of SGD 2.25. Here is the reasoning.

Arrival and the baseline charge. The driver's own GPS trace (EV-GPS-00854) puts him 200.15 m from the Suntec City Tower 3 pickup pin for the whole window, 18:10:00 to 18:14:00 - 25 fixes, stationary (recorded speed 0 km/h), with min, mean and max distance all identical at 200.15 m. The arrival radius for a LARGE_VENUE pickup (EV-TRIP-00854 zone class) is 120 m, and the trace yields 0 qualifying in-radius fixes. POL-NS-02's geofence test therefore fails. POL-NS-01 is conjunctive: limb (b) fails because no in-geofence fix exists at or before the 18:10:00 arrival tap, and limb (c) fails because the dwell, measured from the first qualifying in-geofence fix, is 0 seconds against the 180-second free waiting period in force (EV-TRIP-00854.platform_policy.free_wait_sec). The baseline no-show charge does not stand; both advocates agree on this, and I accept it.

Wrong-entrance outcome (POL-NS-03). The driver was nonetheless stationary for the required dwell - 240 seconds, which meets the 180-second period - at a point outside the 120 m radius but only 200.15 m from the pin, inside the 400 m ceiling. POL-NS-02 says in terms that it yields to POL-NS-03 on these facts, and POL-NS-01 sends the case there too. Under POL-NS-03 the driver did not arrive at the pickup point and the cancellation fee is refunded to the rider in full: SGD 4.50, which matches the fare_breakdown line (EV-FARE-00854 total_charged 4.50, payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00).

Driver's compensation (POL-NS-03(ii)). The chat log (EV-CHAT-00854) shows neither party named an entrance, block, tower or bay - the whole exchange is 'I am here.', 'I am here too.', 'I still cannot see you.' - so limb (i) does not apply, and EV-TRIP-00854 records registered_pickup_points of 3 (2 or more). The mislocation is therefore attributed to pin ambiguity rather than to either party, and the driver receives a platform-funded goodwill payment of 50 percent of the SGD 4.50 fee = SGD 2.25, charged to the platform and never recovered from the rider. Under POL-GEN-03 the rider's refund and the driver's goodwill are independent and are not netted; the ruling value names the filing party's outcome, which is FULL_REFUND.

Claims that do not change the result. POL-NS-04 does not exonerate the rider - the driver replied at 18:10:40, ten seconds after the rider's 18:10:30 message, so limb (b) fails; the rider's point that limb (c) is satisfied (rider_track at 0 m) is accepted but not decisive. POL-NS-05 does not fire: the arrival tap was at 200 m and 0 km/h, inside its 300 m and below its 15 km/h triggers, so the marker is not false and no false-arrival referral arises. POL-NS-12 does not apply because the arrival marker is BUTTON, not GPS_AUTO. POL-NS-06 would also produce a full refund, but the compensation question on an out-of-radius within-400 m stop is governed by POL-NS-03 under POL-NS-02's express carve-out, so the goodwill is payable; the driver's reading of that interaction is correct. The POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip - 1 no-show termination in 30 days against 100 completed trips, rate 0.01, below both thresholds - so compensation is not withheld and none of the rider's money funds it.

Escalation and impairment. No POL-NS-09 trigger fires: the arrival tap and the trace are reconciled by POL-NS-03 rather than left in unresolvable conflict; the pair's disputes_with_counterparty_90d are both 0; rider no_show_disputes_30d is 0; and the deciding evidence is unimpaired under POL-NS-08 - no clock skew (the 18:10:00 arrival event matches the first fix), 25 fixes at a 10-second cadence with max_gap_sec 10, a complete 3-message chat, and a fare line that reconciles. All artifacts the ruling rests on carry weight 1.0, so nothing is discounted and confidence is above the 0.70 floor. The two claims about the missing traffic advisory (EV-ADVIS-00854-01) were discarded by the mechanical check for non-disclosure of that artifact's impairment, and in any event no deciding fact rests on that absent artifact. The lifetime counter prior_no_show_flags was mentioned only to say it cannot be used; it was not relied on.

The monetary effect is SGD 4.50 + SGD 2.25 = SGD 6.75, below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold (POL-GEN-05), so this ruling executes automatically. It is a provisional ruling and either party may appeal under POL-GEN-04.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).

ruling.explanation:
Decision addressed to the rider and the driver. The SGD 4.50 cancellation fee charged on trip TRP-00855 stands, and the driver is paid SGD 3.60.

ARRIVAL AND WAITING PERIOD (driver's POL-NS-12 / POL-NS-01 claims accepted). The trip record EV-TRIP-00855 (weight 1.0) carries the platform's own GPS_AUTO arrival event at 18:10:00 stating distance_to_pickup_m = 0.0, speed_kph = 0.0 and arrival_radius_m = 150, together with wait_timer_started at 18:10:00 and wait_timer_expired at 18:13:00. Under POL-NS-12 those full-resolution platform events are a carrier independent of the exported GPS trace for POL-NS-01 limbs (b) and (c): arrival is established, and the free waiting period in force (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec = 180, with no_show_threshold_sec null) is established as served. Limb (d) also holds: no boarding event is recorded, and the driver terminated at 18:14:00, after the dwell elapsed, with reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW, one of the three codes limb (d) recognises. POL-NS-01 is therefore satisfied in full.

RIDER'S TWO GROUNDS REJECTED. (1) The exported trace EV-GPS-00855 has no qualifying in-radius fix (qualifying_fix_count 0) and reports no horizontal accuracy, so POL-NS-02's three-consecutive-fix test cannot be run on it — but POL-NS-12 supplies the arrival finding from the platform's own measurement, so POL-NS-01 limb (b) does not fail and no refund follows from POL-NS-02. (2) The export's longest qualifying run is 0.0 s, but the effective in-geofence dwell that POL-NS-06 tests is established as served at 180 s under POL-NS-12, so there is no 180-second shortfall and no refund under POL-NS-06.

IMPAIRMENT NAMED. EV-GPS-00855 is impaired: weight_multiplier 0.6, issue code GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW (3 fixes and a 160-second gap inside the waiting window; POL-NS-08(b)). It is weighed only for contradiction and does not contradict: its three driver fixes sit at 0.0 m from the pin at 0 km/h, so it places the driver neither outside the 150 m TRANSPORT_HUB arrival radius nor in motion, and POL-NS-05's false-arrival test is not met. The deciding facts (arrival and the waiting period served) are carried by EV-TRIP-00855 at weight 1.0, independent of the impaired export under POL-NS-12, so the sole-evidence condition of POL-NS-08 and POL-NS-09(e) is not engaged, the POL-GEN-02(2) cap is 1.0, and no escalation arises.

REMAINING CLAUSES. POL-NS-04 does not exonerate the rider: limb (a) fails, because 'I cannot get there in time' is not locating or coordinating content (the rider's position, an entrance/block/tower/bay, a request for the driver's position, or an inability to see the vehicle). POL-NS-03 does not apply: the driver's stationary fixes are at the pin, inside the radius, not at a wrong face of the venue, so no pin-ambiguity goodwill arises. POL-NS-10(a) gives no grace: the trip ran 600 seconds from accepted_at and was ended by a driver no-show termination, not by a rider cancellation inside the 180-second grace. No history-based escalation limb is met (rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d = 0; disputes_with_counterparty_90d = 0 on both profiles).

MONEY. fare_breakdown EV-FARE-00855 shows the cancellation-fee line 4.50, equal to platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd 4.50, so there is no POL-NS-08(d) fare defect. POL-NS-07 fixes the driver's compensation at 80 percent of that net fee: 3.60. The anti-farming check is not tripped (driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d = 1, below the 4-or-more limb; 1 ÷ 100 = 0.01, not above 0.08), so compensation is paid and the ruling is DRIVER_COMPENSATION, with amount_sgd mirroring driver_compensation_sgd at 3.60; the rider's charge stands as it presently is. No clause produces a referral. The monetary effect of SGD 3.60 is below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold, so it executes automatically on issue.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).

ruling.explanation:
To both parties: the trip facts are not in dispute and the record supports them. The driver reached the Paya Lebar pickup pin at 18:10:00 (EV-TRIP-00856, driver 'arrived' event) and stood stationary 0.0 m from it for 240 seconds — 25 fixes at a 10 s cadence, 18:10:00 to 18:14:00 (EV-GPS-00856) — against the 180-second free waiting period in force (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec = 180), a 60-second surplus. All four limbs of POL-NS-01 are therefore satisfied: (a) an arrival event; (b) in-geofence position at that timestamp, inside the 150 m TRANSPORT_HUB arrival radius; (c) a 240-second continuous dwell measured from the first qualifying in-geofence fix, not from the arrival tap (dwell_start_offset_sec 0.0); and (d) a driver termination at 18:14:00 under RIDER_NO_SHOW with no boarding event. So the driver's POL-NS-01 claims and his POL-NS-05 claim (marker set 0.0 m from the pin at 0 km/h, well under the 300 m / 15 km/h false-arrival triggers) are accepted. POL-NS-06 has no shortfall to act on (shortfall_sec = -60, i.e. a surplus). POL-NS-04 does not exonerate the rider: the 18:10:30 message 'I cannot get there in time' names no position, entrance or bay and is not locating or coordinating content under limb (a), and the rider's device sat about 667 m from the pin, outside the 200 m TRANSPORT_HUB rider-presence radius, so limb (c) fails on admissible fixes. The fare line of SGD 4.50 reconciles with the net fee in force (platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd = 4.50), so there is no POL-NS-08(d) fare defect. EV-ADVIS-00856-01 is MISSING, carries weight_multiplier 0.0 and issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT: it can carry no fact, and no traffic advisory can extend the driver's time. That leaves the driver's money, and the record does not yield a payment. POL-NS-07's anti-farming check trips on the driver's own citable trailing-30-day counters (POL-GEN-01): driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d = 5, at or above the threshold of 4, and 5 / completed_trips_30d 50 = 0.10, above the 0.08 rate limb. Both advocates state this on the same figures and neither disputes it; the Driver Advocate concedes it and the Rider Advocate relies on it, and both correctly note that the lifetime counter prior_no_show_flags is CONTEXT ONLY under POL-GEN-01 and is not what the clause reads. Driver compensation of SGD 3.60 (80% of the SGD 4.50 net fee, per the fare breakdown's money block) is accordingly WITHHELD, and POL-NS-09(d) escalates the case. Escalation is terminal: no money moves now, and the disputed SGD 4.50 (not the SGD 6.61 gross figure) is held rather than collected or refunded, so both money fields are null. The rider's argument that ESCALATE is the only disposition that does not leave the charge standing is accepted, with one qualification: NO_ACTION would indeed have left the SGD 4.50 with the rider, because POL-GEN-03 makes NO_ACTION party-relative, but the anti-farming branch displaces that route, and escalation here is a holding rather than a rider win on the merits. No repeat-pairing or rider-side abuse ground is present: rider_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d and driver_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d are both 0 (POL-NS-09(c)), and rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0 (POL-NS-09(d) rider limb), so the driver's assertion that those limbs are not engaged is accepted. Confidence 0.90: the deciding facts — the arrival and dwell measured on EV-GPS-00856 and EV-TRIP-00856, and the anti-farming counters on EV-DPROF-00856 — each rest on artifacts at weight_multiplier 1.0, so the POL-GEN-02 cap is 1.0. Nothing is impaired under POL-NS-08(a) to (d): no clock skew (arrival and termination timestamps match the trace), no sampling gap longer than 120 s, the chat log's 2 messages match chat_message_count 2, and the fare reconciles. The monetary effect is SGD 4.50, below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold, but as escalation holds the sum it does not execute.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).
referrals: POL-NS-07 (anti-farming): direct the human reviewer to refund the rider's cancellation fee of SGD 4.50 in full — the driver's compensation is withheld on the clause's own check (no_show_terminations_30d 5 is 4 or more; 5 / completed_trips_30d 50 = 0.10, above the 0.08 rate ceiling) and the disputed fee is held rather than collected or refunded while review is pending.
